senses.definition: vb. bend down (Arabic خَفَضَ lower, depress, as wings Qor 15:88)—only
Impf. יַחְפֹּץ זְנָכוֹ כְמוֹ־אֶרֶז Jb 40:17; he bendeth down (extendeth down stiffly) his tail like a cedar, v. Wetzst in De Job 526 Hi Hiob 299.
